entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How may I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. And I'm already annoyed, so let's try to make this quick.
I understand, sir. I'll do my best to assist you. Can I get your order number, please?
It's #VF12345. I want to return a VeloBand Pulse. This thing is junk.
Okay, I see order #VF12345 here. It includes a VeloBand Pulse. Could you tell me what the issue is?
The issue is it doesn't work! The pulse readings are completely off, and the app keeps crashing. I bought it like, 2 weeks ago.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand Pulse. I understand the frustration. Our standard return policy is 90 days. So, returning it shouldn't be a problem.
90 days? Really? Thank goodness. I thought I was stuck with this expensive paperweight. So, what do I need to do?

We can definitely process a return for you. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label right away. Just pack the VeloBand Pulse back in its original packaging, if possible, attach the label, and drop it off at any authorized carrier location. Once we receive it, we'll issue a full refund.
Alright, that sounds easy enough. What about the smart watch I ordered with it? That one's fine, thankfully.
The shipping label will be for the entire order. I'll make a note to only process the return for the VeloBand Pulse. You can keep the smart watch. Do you understand everything so far?
Yeah, yeah, send the label. The sooner this thing is out of my house, the better.
Okay, the label has been sent to the email address associated with your account. Please allow a few minutes for it to arrive. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it. I appreciate you actually making this easy, unlike that stupid VeloBand Pulse.
You're welcome. We value your business. Have a good day!
